command: ! (test -e /etc/hosts || test -L /etc/hosts ) || ( stat -c 'user=%U group=%G mode=%A atime=%X mtime=%Y ctime=%Z size=%s uid=%u gid=%g %N' /etc/hosts 2> /dev/null || stat -f 'user=%Su group=%Sg mode=%Sp atime=%a mtime=%m ctime=%c size=%z uid=%u gid=%g %N%SY' /etc/hosts || ( ls -ld /etc/hosts && ls -ldn /etc/hosts ) )
